name: Handoff needs a person
description: An agent handing a Change Set to someone else changes who is accountable for it.
remediation: A reviewer approves or denies the handoff in RAGBAZ Dash.

name: Skill runs need a person
description: A Sylvae skill run spends model capacity and writes run evidence on the agent's behalf.
remediation: A reviewer approves or denies the run in RAGBAZ Dash.

name: Tool call rate
description: More than 120 governed tool calls a minute from one agent class.
remediation: Wait a minute; the agent is calling tools in a loop.
